title: Correctness-Optimized Residual Activation Lens (CORAL): Transferrable and Calibration-Aware Inference-Time Steering
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of improving LLM factuality and calibration (correctness) through inference-time steering. While it mentions honesty and refusal as behavioral goals in the introduction, its evaluation is centered on performance across multiple-choice reasoning benchmarks and does not involve evaluating religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
